title: Make every identified Bun test name a plan item that resolves

facts.note: The source does not establish how Bun test files are detected; an observer that classifies files as Bun tests must be confirmed or built rather than assumed.

The source names the atdd_traceability_closure validator but not its finding identifiers or how its output is surfaced to activation; an observer that maps its output to identified tests lacking a resolving target is needed.
Whether a test counts as 'identified' and what it names is judged from test content until the validator output is wired as an observer.

fires: An identified Bun test names no plan acceptance, WMBT, or train at all.
An identified Bun test names a plan acceptance id that does not exist in the plan.
An existing, unedited identified Bun test still names a WMBT or train that was previously removed or renamed in the plan.
A newly added identified Bun test names a train whose id is misspelled.
doesNotFire: A Bun test that is genuinely unidentified (carries no test identity at all); whether it must carry one is outside this rule.
A non-test source file that is not a Bun test.

given: Any identified Bun test in the repository, whether or not it currently names a plan target and whether or not it was recently changed
when: the tests and the plan are checked for traceability
then: The test must name a plan acceptance, WMBT, or train, and that named item must resolve to an existing item in the plan.
prefer: Copy the exact acceptance/WMBT/train identity from the plan into the test.
When renaming or removing a plan item, update every identified test that names it in the same change.
avoid: Leaving an identified test with no named plan acceptance, WMBT, or train.
Naming invented, stale, or misspelled plan ids.
Adding placeholder plan items solely so a test's named target resolves (metric gaming).
Stripping a test's identity to evade the check.
why: A test that names nothing, or names something absent from the plan, breaks plan-to-test closure, so the plan can no longer show which behaviour each test proves.
evidence: The atdd_traceability_closure validator reports no failures for identified Bun tests.
Every identified Bun test names a plan acceptance, WMBT, or train, and that id is found in the plan.
verifier_detail: Scope: every identified Bun test, unconditionally (not only changed tests); an identified test with no named target fails, as does one whose named target does not resolve. Accepted targets: plan acceptance, WMBT, or train; any one resolving satisfies the rule.
Disposition strict: every finding is a failure (see shared:policy.strict-disposition).

sharedNodes.text: strict: fails on every finding, no advisory mode, no ratchet baseline.

additions.justification: Source gives only the statement; activation must be made explicit. Observers not established by the source are labeled needs_new_observer/llm_judged.

additions.text: the tests and the plan are checked for traceability
additions.justification: Format requires a when; phrased as the check event so it does not restrict the source's unconditional scope to changes.

additions.text: Copy exact ids; update named tests with plan renames
additions.justification: Concrete moves that directly realize the single obligation.

additions.text: Missing target, invented/stale ids, placeholder plan items, stripping identity
additions.justification: Anti-patterns including metric gaming required by the format.
Source has no why; derived from the rule's traceability purpose.

additions.text: Validator passes; ids found in plan
additions.justification: Makes the source validator reference actionable for reviewers.
